title: Astra vs GeneratePress
description: A documentation-led comparison of Astra’s broad template ecosystem and GeneratePress’s deliberate block-editor workflow.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Astra versus GeneratePress WordPress comparison from KreativWP.
comparisonAreas: Same-content performance, accessibility, and support tests still required
takeaway: Astra is the more natural research starting point when templates and editor flexibility lead the decision. GeneratePress is worth prioritizing when the team prefers composing a lean site system deliberately in the block editor.

decisionGuide.chooseLeft: starter sites, broad editor compatibility, and a flexible first build matter more than a narrowly prescribed workflow.
decisionGuide.chooseRight: your team is comfortable building deliberately with blocks and wants to keep the site system considered and composable.
decisionGuide.verify: Use the same content, host, image strategy, and required plugins in both. Do not infer performance or support quality from documented features alone.

rows.label: Free starting point
rows.left: Free classic theme with Customizer controls; choose your own content editor.
rows.right: Free classic theme with Customizer controls; WordPress core blocks work without GP Premium.

rows.label: Site-system workflow
rows.left: Theme controls plus a broad starter-template ecosystem; verify the dependencies of the selected template.
rows.right: Core theme plus optional GP Premium and GenerateBlocks; paid Block Elements support composed site areas.

rows.label: Paid-feature boundaries
rows.left: Astra Pro adds theme features; templates and other products may belong to separate packages.
rows.right: GP Premium is separate from the free theme. Block Elements require the appropriate premium feature set.

rows.label: What was tested locally
rows.left: Free theme: representative page, editor save, article rendering, and mobile navigation.
rows.right: The same free-theme fixture and functional checks. These do not establish a performance winner.

migration: The linked profiles contain the local free-theme evidence. Before changing a real site, export Customizer choices, audit template and block-plugin dependencies, and rebuild a representative header on staging. Starter-template imports are not a tested migration path.
